paragraphs.text: The Bolas Arc is the storyline that tells the story of the fight of the Gatewatch against Nicol Bolas , culminating in his defeat after the War of the Spark . It is the second major Planeswalker storyline after the Eldrazi Arc .

It comprises the Kaladesh block , Amonkhet block , Ixalan block , Dominaria , Core Set 2019 , and the " Guilds of Ravnica block ". The Arc finishes Bolas's storyline set up by the Legends Cycle II , Time Spiral Cycle , A Planeswalker Novel and Alara Unbroken , with the Battle for Zendikar block and Shadows over Innistrad block setting up the Gatewatch as part of the Eldrazi Arc .

In terms of sets, it includes eleven expansion sets released from September 2016 until April 2019: Kaladesh , Aether Revolt , Amonkhet , Hour of Devastation , Ixalan , Rivals of Ixalan , Dominaria , Core Set 2019 , Guilds of Ravnica , Ravnica Allegiance and War of the Spark . "Codename: Handlebar" was the term used internally.
Bolas's arc picks up again starting from the Tarkir: Dragonstorm story.
